text:
clare: Noticed an oddity in the latency dashboard just now — aggregate p99 for /v1/respond is ~640ms at 13:42 but the endpoint breakdown p99 is ~210ms. any ideas?
omar: sounds like an origin/provenance mismatch. did you include proxy-origin or retries?
clare: dashboard was default. I expected both views to match.
yin: we changed endpoint tiles to show server-origin only last month. aggregate keeps all origins. that can create big deltas when fallback/proxy traffic is slow.
miguel: Also check retries + cache_hit. a proxy fallback path had a lot of cache_misses and a couple of retries in traces. example ingress: `ingress: endpoint=/v1/respond origin=proxy fallback=true latency_ms=621 retry_count=1 cache_hit=false`
telemetry-bot: quick stats -> proxy p99=602ms (n=180), server p99=208ms (n=1920) for 2026-03-23T13:30Z..2026-03-23T13:50Z
omar: Confirmed. UX gotcha: console shows p99 but no provenance indicator on the percentile row so oncall assumed backend regression.
clare: Proposal: provenance pill next to percentile numbers + hover showing per-origin counts and percentiles. also an "exclude retries" toggle in the percentile panel.
yin: agree. telemetry already tags `sample_origin`, `retry_count`, `cache_hit`. small API flag `include_retries` should do it.
miguel: Minimal repro query to attach to incident: `SELECT percentile(latency_ms,99) AS p99, sample_origin, cache_hit, count(*) FROM telemetry.samples WHERE endpoint='/v1/respond' AND time >= '2026-03-23T13:30Z' AND time <= '2026-03-23T13:50Z' GROUP BY sample_origin, cache_hit ORDER BY p99 DESC;`
omar: Action items: (1) console: add provenance pill + hover (yin), (2) telemetry API: add include_retries param and return origin breakdown (omar), (3) docs blurb on why percentiles differ across slices (clare). I'll file an incident note now.
clare: thanks all. short-term UX patch would prevent unnecessary pages.
